method: Written (translated from the English seeds) by an Anthropic model in a subscription chat session on 2026-11-20. No API key, no API calls and no API spend: expand_languages.py was not used, because no API credit could be verified. Model authored, not written by a person and not reviewed by a native speaker; pending native speaker review. The same structural gates and the same semantic back-check test as every stored file were applied (python expand_languages.py --check-stored). The English back-translations were written by the same model, so that check cannot catch an error the model believes is correct, and passing the automated language identification and similarity scores does not show that the meaning or the naturalness is right.
